objective: Prototype application-defined contextual navigation in Woodshed and Knot with shared Cambium history and controls.

owners.cambium: Generic place and anchor history, reusable navigation controls. Browser scope policy stays in the GUI chat's browser migration.
owners.woodshed: Overview, owning Set and Card occurrence routes; presentation restoration independent of practice and rehearsal.
owners.knot: Site, live document and recursive section routes; source validation and selection restoration independent of editing history.

done_conditions: Shared controls accept arbitrary application destinations without a fixed scope ladder.
Woodshed distinguishes the same material in different Sets and restores the actual entry context.
Woodshed navigation preserves playback owner, transport and rehearsal cursor.
Knot traverses nested sections including skipped heading levels and returns to the live buffer.
Knot navigation does not revert unsaved text or edit history and rejects stale source locations.
Both native app targets compile and focused regressions pass against the same shared source.
Documentation records exact qualification limits and remaining native interaction gates.

optional: bounded native screenshots if a usable local fixture is available
